comment: Website-local (not a desktop vector): sync-v2.md §7/§14 phase 7b — the website emits `epoch` on its ChangesPage and enforces it on POST /api/v1/sync/changes (INV-13). Seed a MIRROR scope at the minted epoch 0 with one journal row; the page must carry epoch 0. A handover flip to authority bumps dataset.journal_epoch, and the very NEXT page must carry that bump (epoch 1) — this is the wiring that lets a writer that missed the handover re-pull, record the new epoch, and retry. `staleEpochReason` is pinned to the desktop hub's byte-identical refusal (learning/fms-app sync/rest.rs sync_changes), and `staleEpochRefused` proves the gate is strictly `presented < authority`: a lower writer is refused (change stays queued), an at-or-ahead writer is accepted. scopeAuthorityEpoch(@app) === 0 shows the shipped cloud-authority leg never trips the gate (the website is @app's native authority; no handover applies) — zero regression.

expect.stale_string: stale_epoch: presented 0 < authority 1 for scope '66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666'; re-pull this scope to learn the new epoch, then retry (INV-13/INV-20)
